titleEn: Who is considered a Sahib al-Tartib?
questionEn: For whom is maintaining order in making up missed prayers obligatory?
summaryEn: According to this ruling, if fewer than six obligatory prayers are outstanding, maintaining order is obligatory. If six or more obligatory prayers are outstanding, maintaining order is not obligatory. Witr is not counted toward the six-prayer threshold.
contentEn: A person who has fewer than six obligatory prayers outstanding is treated as a Sahib al-Tartib. If six or more obligatory prayers are owed as qaza, maintaining order is not obligatory. Witr prayers are not included in this count. For example, if the prayers from one Fajr until the next Fajr become due as qaza, maintaining their order when making them up is not obligatory. If fewer than six missed obligatory prayers are owed, maintaining order is obligatory. And Allah Most High knows best.
